chapter.verse: Tua laitak mite khatlekhat kisikkha zah dongin tul tampi hong kikaihkhop uh ciangin Jesu in a nungzuite' kiangah hih bangin thugen masa hi: "Puatham kineihna ahi Pharisee-te' silngo kidawm un.
A kilaakkhia lo dinga kiseelcip thu leh a kitheithang lo dinga ki-imcip thu cih bang om lo hi.
Tua hi a, khuamial sunga na gen peuhpeuh uh khuavak sungah kiza ding a, inndei sungtawnga na kigen khiankhian uh thute innkhuma tungah kitangko ding hi.
"Ka lawmte aw, kong gen ding hi. Pumpi thatin tua bansiah hihtheih bangmah a neilote kihta kei un.
Ahih hangin kua kihta ding cih kong theisak ding hi. A thah khit ciangin hellb sung lotsuk ding hihtheihna thu a neipa kihta un. Himah hi, ke'n kong cihin ah amah kihta un!
Gitta nga ciangin assarionc tang nih tawh kizuak hilo ahi hiam? Hinapi, Pasian' mai-ah tuate khat beek kimangngilh lo hi.
A taktakin na lu tung uh-a samzangte nangawn a vekin kisim khin hi. Lau kei un; note gitta tampitak sangin na manphazaw uh hi.
"Ke'n kong cihin ah, mite' mai-ah kei hong pulak khempeuh Mihing' Tapa in zong Pasian' vanmite' mai-ah pulak ding hi.
Ahih hangin mite' mai-ah kei hong nialte Pasian' vanmite' mai-ah nialna ngah ding uh hi.
Tua banah Mihing' Tapa langpanna kam khat a paute khempeuh kimaisak ding a, ahi zongin Kha Siangtho a gendai mi kimaisak lo ding hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in vengkhawm innte, uliante leh ukna neite' mai-ah note hong tut uh ciangin bangci kihut ding cih ahi-a bangci pau ding cih ahi zongin lunghimawh kei un.
A hang pen tua hunlenai ciangin Kha Siangtho in na gen ding teng uh hong hilh ding hi."
Mihonpi lakpan mi khat in Jesu' kiangah, "Sya aw, ka sanggampa in gamh hong hop nading hong gensak in," ci hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu in, "Mipa aw, nang' tungah thukhen ding, ahihkeileh thulemtuahd dingin kua in kei hong seh ahi hiam?" ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute' kiangah, "Kidawm unla huaihamna nam khempeuh pan kigalging un. Banghanghiam cihleh mi khat' nuntakna pen ama' neihlelam tampite sungah om lo hi," ci hi.
A kizomin amaute' kiangah hih bangin thugenteh khat gen hi: "Mihau khat a lo ah an tampi piang a,
tua hangin a lungsim sungah, 'Ka ante khol nading mun nei nawnlo ka hih manin bang ka cih ding hiam?' ci hi.
Tua ciangin, 'Ka hici hih ding hi. Ka ansalte phelin a golzaw tekin ka lam ding a, ka antang teng leh ka van teng a vekin tuate sungah ka seng ding hi.
Tua ciangin ka nunna kha' kiangah, "Nunna kha aw, kum sawtpi na khom ding vanlena kholsa tampi na nei hi. Tawlnga inla ne-in dawnin nuamsa in," ka ci ding hi,' ci hi.
Ahih hangin Pasian in mihaupa' kiangah, 'Mihaitatpa! Tu zanin nang' kiangpan na hinna hong kingenkik ding hi. Tua hileh na bawlkholhsa nate kua' a a suak ding hiam?' ci hi.
Tua hi a, ama' ading bek neihlelam kholin Pasian' lamah a hau lote zong tua mah bang ahi hi."

Tua ciangin Jesu in a nungzuite' kiangah hih bangin gen hi: "Tua hi a, note kong cihin ah bang ne ding ci-in na nuntakna uh' ading ahi zongin, bang silh ding ci-in na pumpi uh' ading ahi zongin lunghimawh kei un.
A hang pen an sangin nuntakna thupizaw a, puan sangin pumpi thupizaw hi.
Va-akte lungngai dih un; amaute in khaici lah tuh lo, an lah la lo, sungpi leh ansal lah nei lo napi uh Pasian in amaute vak veve hi. Tua vasate sangin note bangzah tak manphazaw ding!
Tua banah note lakah lunghihmawh manin ama' nuntak sautan tong khat beek a khangkhan thei kua om na hi uh hiam?
Tua bang thu nengno khat nangawn hih theilo na hih uhleh bang hangin a dang teng lunghimawh na hi uh hiam?

Unok kungte bangci khan cih lungngai dih un. Tuate in naham zong sem lo, khau lah khek lo uh hi. Hinapi ke'n kong cihin ah Solomon nangawn a thupitna teng tawh a kithawi laitak hihte khat zahin etlawm lo lai hi.
No, upna neute aw! Tuni hingin zingciang meikhuk sunga kilawnsuk gamlak lopate Pasian in puansilh guan ahihleh note hong zemzaw kan ding hilo hiam?
Bang ne ding, bang dawn ding cih ngaihsunsun kei unla, zong lunghimawh kei un.
A hang pen leitung minam khempeuh in hih nate zonpi-in nei uh a, na Pa un zong tuate na kisap lam uh thei hi.
Tua sangin ama' kumpigam zongzaw un. Tua hileh tua nate hong kipiathuah ding hi.
"Tuuhon tawmcikte aw, lau kei un. A hang pen note kumpigam hong piak ding na pa uh' hong deihsak thu ahi hi.
Na neihsate uh zuak unla citpiak huhna-in zang un. A lui a ngot theilo sumbawm ahi, gutate' neh zawhloh leh nget' nektum theihlohna mun, a kiam ngeilo vantung sumkholna khat, bawl un.
A hang pen na sumkholna mun uhah na lungsim uh zong om ding hi.
"Kawnggak a gaksa-in om unla na meivak uh a kuangsa-in koih un.
Mopawi siimna pan inn hong ciah ding a topa uh, inn tungin kong a kiuh lian leh, kongkhak a hon pah thei dinga a na ngak gige mite tawh kibang un.
A topa a tun hunin teitak-a om a muhkhak silate thuphangah ahi hi. Maantak kong cihin ah a topa in nasep puan silhin sabuai ah a silate tusak ding a, amahmah hong pai-in ankuang luui ding hi.
Khuazat khit ahihkeileh zankim khit hunin amah hong pai henla amaute teitak-a om a muh leh tua silate thuphangah ahi hi.
Ahih hangin hih thu theitel un: inntekpa in gutapa hong pai ding hunlenai theician hileh a inn a kiluh zah dongin vaksan lo ding hi.
Note zong na upmawh loh uh hunlenai ah Mihing' Tapa hong pai ding ahih manin a kigingsa-in na om loh uh phamawh hi."
Peter in, "Topa aw, hih thugenteh nong gen pen kote' ading bek hiam? Ahihkeileh vekpi' ading ahi hiam?" ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in hih bangin ci hi: "Tua ahihleh a kiseh hunin innsung nasemte amau' anguai tek a pia dingin a topa in panmun a guat, a citak leh a lungpil innsung thuvanpa kua ahi hiam?
A topa' hong pai ciangin tua bangin nasemin om a muh tua silapa thuphangah ahi hi.
Maantak kong cihin ah a topa in a neihsa khempeuh a kem dingin vaipuak ap ding hi.
Ahih hangin tua silapa in a lungsim sungah, 'Ka topa hong ciah hak lai ding hi,' ci-in sawltangzang numeite leh pasalte sat gawp henla zune sane-in na kham gawp hileh,
silapa' upmawh loh hunleni khat leh a theihkholh loh hunlenai khat ah a topa tung ding a, silapa' tungah a suksiabel gawtna nam pia-in a muanhuailo mite tawh koihkhawm ding hi.
Tua ciangin a topa' deihna thei napi a kigingkhol lo, a topa' deihna banga a gamta lo tua silapa in vuakna satna nakpi thuak ding hi.

Ahih hangin a topa' deihna a theilo, satliam thuak dinga kilawm silapa ahihleh tawmno khat bek thuak ding hi. Tampi a ngah khempeuh tampi kingenkik ding a, mite in tampi a ki-apna mipa' kiangpan a tamzaw kal ding uh hi.
"Leitung ah mei a tawhkuang dingin hong pai ka hi a, kitawhkuang ta hileh ka ut hi.
Ka san ding baptizena khat om a, tua vai a kikhit mateng ka lunggimna lian lua hi.
Leitung ah nopna lemna a puak dinga hong pai hong sa na hi uh hiam? Hilo hi. Ke'n kong cihin ah kikhenna a puak ding ka hizaw hi.
A hang pen tu-a kipan innkuan khat sunga mi ngate, a langkhat ah thum, a langkhat ah nih, kikhenkham ding uh hi.
Mite kikhenkham ding uh a, pa in tapa, tapa in pa, nu in tanu, tanu in nu, teknu in a monu, monu in teknu, langpang ding hi."
Jesu in mihonpi' kiangah zong hih bangin gen hi: "Nitumlam ah meiilom om na muh uh ciangin, 'Guahzu ding hi,' ci-in na gen thei pah uh a, zong zu takpi hi.
Leitawlam pan huih hong nun ciangin, 'Ni sa mahmah ding hi,' na ci uh a, tuaci pah hi.
No a puatham kineihte aw, leitung leh vantung a maisuah khentel thei napi-in bang hangin tu laitak hun khentel theilo na hi uh hiam?
"Tua banah note' adinga a dik thu, bang hangin khinkhai theilo na hi uh hiam?

Na thulangpa tawh ulianpa' kiangah na paikhop laitak lampi ah amah tawh kilem nading hanciam in. Tua hikeileh amah in thukhen mangpa' mai-ah nang hong kai ding a, thukhen mangpa in thong ukpa' kiangah hong apin thong ukpa in thong sungah hong khum ding hi.
Ke'n kong cihin ah leptonf khat zong siit lo-in liausum na khitsiang mateng na suakta ngeikei ding hi."Kisik Nading Hansuahna
